# Sound Check with Drew Brashler

> A practical audio engineering newsletter focused on church PA systems, Behringer WING console workflows, and live sound mixing techniques.

Sound Check with Drew Brashler provides in-depth guides, case studies, and video courses for audio engineers working in church and live sound environments. The site specializes in Behringer WING console setup, wireless microphone systems, PA optimization, and mixing fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Behringer WING
- Church Audio
- Live Sound PA Systems
- AES50 Digital Audio
- Wireless Microphones
- Audio Mixing
- XLR Balanced Audio
- Behringer X-Air
- StageConnect Devices
- DCA and Mixbus Techniques
- Microphone Feedback Prevention
- Monitor Mixing (IEM)
- Gain Staging
- Speaker Placement
- Audio Troubleshooting

## WING Console Setup & Configuration

- [Connect Two Behringer WINGs to One DL32 - Complete Guide](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/connect-two-behringer-wing-same-dl32): Complete guide to dual WING console setup with Midas DL32 and AES50.
- [WING Sync Source and Clock: How to Set Up AES50 Correctly](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/behringer-wing-sync-source-aes50): Guide to configuring AES50 clock sync for WING and S32 stage box.
- [WING ALT Input: Backup Mics and Virtual Sound Check Setup](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/wing-alt-input-backup-virtual-soundcheck): Guide to using WING ALT input for backup microphones and soundcheck.
- [The WING Just Got a Massive (Free) Dynamics Upgrade | Firmware 3.1](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/the-wing-just-got-a-massive-free-dynamics-upgrade): Overview of WING Firmware 3.1 dynamics processor improvements.
- [New Behringer WING StageConnect Devices from NAMM 2026](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/new-wing-stageconnect-devices-from-namm-2026): Overview of new Behringer SC series StageConnect devices and features.

## Audio Mixing Fundamentals

- [Complete Behringer X-Air Course](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/complete-xair-course): 5-hour video course on Behringer X-Air mixer for audio engineers.
- [Exploring Mixbusses](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/exploring-mixbusses): Guide to 6 distinct applications of mixbusses in audio mixing.
- [When to use DCA's](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/use-dcas): Guide to using DCAs for efficient multi-channel control.
- [Setting the Preamp Level Correctly](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/setting-preamp-level-correctly): Guide to proper preamp level configuration and gain staging.
- [Two Reverb Settings That Might Be Making Your Mix Muddy](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/reverb-pre-delay-low-cut): Tips on reverb pre-delay and low cut settings for cleaner vocal mixing.

## Live Sound & PA Systems

- [Balanced vs Unbalanced Audio: What Church Teams Should Know](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/your-cable-choice-matters-more-than-you-think): Guide to balanced/unbalanced audio connections, XLR, and DI box usage.
- [Preventing Microphone Feedback in a Live Sound PA](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/preventing-microphone-feedback): Steps for preventing microphone feedback in live sound PA systems.
- [Church PA System Optimization: Move, Repair, or Replace?](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/church-pa-system-optimization): Case study on diagnosing and fixing PA coverage issues with Meyer M1D speakers.
- [Simple way to troubleshoot an audio console](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/youre-going-problems): Framework for troubleshooting audio console no-sound issues.

## Wireless & Monitor Systems

- [A Path to No Wireless Dropouts](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/path-no-wireless-dropouts): Guide to wireless antenna selection and placement for dropout prevention.
- [Monitor Mixing - Don't Destroy your IEM Mix](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/destroying-iem-mix): Guide to wireless IEM monitor mixing and pilot tone issues.

## Audio Equipment & Interfaces

- [Behringer Flow 4V and Flow 4VIO: Everything You Need to Know](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/behringer-flow-4v-flow-4vio-complete-guide): Complete guide to Behringer Flow audio interfaces and WING compatibility.
- [My Favorite Products from NAMM 2026 for Church Audio Teams](https://newsletter.drewbrashler.com/p/namm-2026-best-products-for-church-audio-teams): Product recommendations from NAMM 2026 including Shure SLX-D+ wireless.
